notes:
Context: PivotRidge is a mid-market PLG SaaS that embeds conversational support + doc search in their product. Ran a 30-day Hosted API trial to validate latency, cost, and model quality before committing to Dedicated. Trial findings (raw):
- Avg sustained QPS observed: 6-10 qps across US region (baseline), regular daily peak windows 08:30-11:00 PST hitting 16-18 qps.
- Peak concurrent open chat sessions during business hours: observed up to 22 flows; average concurrency (p95) ~12.
- Token profile: average total tokens/request ~1,450 (prompt ~580, completion ~870). Token mix roughly 40% prompt / 60% completion.
- Heavy usage patterns: short chat turns but long context windows for user history + attachments; nightly batch embeddings jobs (approx 200 requests, 8-12k tokens each) for indexing new docs.
- Latency: Hosted API p95 generation ~340ms on smaller models, p95 for the larger 13B quantized variant ~520ms (acceptable for async flows, borderline for live support).
POC ask: Dedicated sizing & cost forecast to cover daytime live chat SLAs (p95 <250ms target) + nightly embedding/ingest throughput without impacting chat SLOs.
Requested topology preferences: prefer quantized open models (13B) on Dedicated for cost, with fallback to smaller low-latency variants for high-concurrency windows. Want routing by policy (latency first for live chat, cost-first for background tasks).
Security/compliance: EU customer base requires data residency for user transcripts; SSO/SAML mandatory; SOC2 required; KMS for key management; audit logs retention 1 year. Legal flagged a requirement for an EU data residency clause in contract.
Business/value: Expect to convert to Dedicated if Dedicated TCO < current hosted spend projected at scale and if latency targets met. Estimated ARR for Redwood deal: $150k-$300k/year; procurement decision Q2.
Quotes from stakeholder: 'We need predictable latency during support spikes — outages cost us renewals' (Head of Product).
Next steps (short): 1) Dedicated sizing workshop (workshop to model QPS/concurrency/token mix + residual capacity) 2) Redwood to deliver dedicated pricing workbook and sizing diagram 3) Legal to review EU residency addendum 4) SE to run a short stress POC on Dedicated equivalent (3-4 day) to validate p95 and fallback routing.
Open questions: can Dedicated meet p95 <250ms with 13B quant on our expected concurrency and embedding throughput? What is recommended kv/prefix cache configuration for long user histories?
CRM shorthand entries: demo flagged, cost-sensitive, wants staged rollout (canary -> 50% -> 100%), prefers invoices over credit card, procurement slated for late Apr if blockers cleared.
